rows.grounds: compound of maṇḍala (circle-period), dina (day), and avadhi (limit, boundary), indicating the duration up to the end of the maṇḍala days

items.question: What temporal boundary marks the endpoint of the prescribed maṇḍala period?
premises: The preceding context specifies a duration measured in maṇḍala days.
The compound maṇḍaladināvadhi denotes a limit defined by those days.
items.inference: The prescribed observance extends up to the limit of the maṇḍala days.
items.plain_english: Up to the limit of the maṇḍala days.
